invariants.description: i is the exact rectangular pulse train: -stim_flag i_amplitude while t_start <= t <= t_end and (t - t_start) mod period <= pulse_duration, else 0 (samples within 1e-9 s of an edge excluded)
invariants.expr: (lambda N, i, t, s, e, P, d, a: N.all((N.abs(i - N.where((t >= s) & (t <= e) & (N.mod(t - s, P) <= d), a, 0.0)) <= 1e-9*max(abs(a), 1e-300)) | (N.minimum(N.mod(t - s, P), P - N.mod(t - s, P)) < 1e-9) | (N.abs(N.mod(t - s, P) - d) < 1e-9) | (N.abs(t - e) < 1e-9)))(np, i, t, t_start, t_end, period, pulse_duration, -stim_flag*i_amplitude)

invariants.description: charge per period: over the first two full periods the integral of i equals 2 (-stim_flag i_amplitude pulse_duration) to within one output step of samples (trapezoid)
invariants.expr: (t_start + 2*period > t[-1]) or (t_end < t_start + 2*period) or (abs(np.trapezoid(np.where((t >= t_start) & (t < t_start + 2*period), i, 0.0), t) - 2*(-stim_flag*i_amplitude*pulse_duration)) <= 2*stim_flag*abs(i_amplitude)*(t[1] - t[0]) + 1e-15)

bc_sweep.rationale: Periods 0.33-2 s (30-180 beats/min), 1-10 ms pulses and 0.1-20 nA amplitudes cover hiPSC-CM (0.55 nA, Paci 2013) to adult-myocyte-scale stimuli. t_end = 1 s checks that pacing stops; stim_flag 0 checks the switch.

baseline.reason: prescribed stimulus waveform (an input); verified against its exact analytic pulse train

calibrate.note: not_applicable: prescribed stimulus waveform (an input); verified against its exact analytic pulse train
